description: This file defines a struct 'SingleSegmentBuffer' that implements the IBufferWriter<byte> interface, providing buffer management functionalities such as advancing, retrieving memory/spans, converting to array, resetting, and converting to string.

classes.name: SingleSegmentBuffer
classes.description: A struct implementing IBufferWriter<byte> for managing a single segment buffer with methods for advancing, retrieving memory/spans, converting to array, resetting, and string representation.

methods.name: SingleSegmentBuffer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the buffer with a byte array and setting written bytes to zero.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the written position by a specified number of bytes.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Returns a Memory<byte> starting from the current written position.

methods.name: GetSpan
methods.description: Returns a Span<byte> starting from the current written position.

methods.name: ToArray
methods.description: Converts the written portion of the buffer to a byte array.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the buffer's written position to zero.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Property returning the number of bytes written.

methods.name: GetReadOnlySpan
methods.description: Returns a ReadOnlySpan<byte> of the written data.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts the written buffer data to a UTF8 string.
